messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — I'm going to start the lockfile bump for v2.4.0 in ~30m. Need owners for:
- submodule updates (gRPC-proto, telemetry)
- vendor/lib sync for platform-shared
If you can take one, reply here. I'll tag for the cutover checklist.

sam: I can take gRPC-proto submodule. Will open PR and link.

leo: I’ll handle vendor sync for platform-shared. Planning to run the vendor script and post diffs.

jen: I can do telemetry submodule. Any special merge order?

marta: Thanks. Order: 1) gRPC-proto 2) telemetry 3) vendor sync. CI flakiness warning: please run `./scripts/check-locks.sh` locally before push.

sam: ack. PR will be `release/lock-bump-grpc-2123` — pinging @jen for schema changes.

jen: will validate schemas; if anything breaks I'll push a small compatibility shim.

kai: Heads-up from infra: please bump the runtime image tag in the submodule before merge (`image: redwood/runtime:2026-02-15`). Otherwise staging workers fail.

ci-bot: build triggered for sam/PR#456 — unit tests passed, integration tests queued.

leo: vendor diff preview:
```
- github.com/old/dep v1.2.0 -> v1.3.1
+ github.com/new/lib v0.9.4
```
I'll keep changes minimal; will add a commit with vendor/ + go.sum.

marta: also note changelog: add an entry under "deps" about the gRPC change. release-mgr: can we slot these merges before cutoff at 21:00 UTC?

release-mgr: cutoff is 21:00 UTC. If all PRs are green and merged by 20:30 we'll be fine. Otherwise hold for next window.

sam: PR opened, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/456

jen: telemetry PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/457 — needs schema review.

leo: vendor PR ready in draft state.

kai: infra smoke passed on my staging cluster with the bumped image.

marta: sweet. I'll run the final `./scripts/sync-locks.sh` after merges and push the combined lock commit. If anyone wants to test locally, run:
```
git fetch origin && git checkout release/candidate && ./scripts/sync-locks.sh
```
Please react with :thumbsup: when you finish your point.

sam: :thumbsup:
jen: :thumbsup:
leo: :thumbsup:
kai: :thumbsup:
ci-bot: merged sam/PR#456 — checks complete.

marta: merging telemetry when CI passes. Thanks all.
